## Bitrix24 example adapter v1.0
Checked against official docs on 2026-07-14.

- Configure the portal `/rest` base URL in this workflow and bind an OAuth2 credential with `crm` and `task` scopes.
- Lead uses current universal `crm.item.list/add/update` with `entityTypeId=1`; deprecated `crm.lead.*` is not used.
- Only records owned by `originatorId=n8n-starter-kit` and the same idempotency key are updated. Multiple matches stop safely.
- Task uses `tasks.task.add`. Default test mode bypasses all HTTP nodes.
